s2_preapproval.text: 预批「采集窗 authoring 例外」——常规 util<40 不达标时允许 authoring-only util<60；条件：① 仅采集窗生效，G-L0 pilot 仍按常规阈值、不适用例外；② 仍须 S-2 双签（计划 + 基线 + signed floor = baseline_free − 3072 MiB）后才开 G-L1；③ 失败即停、不重试、不放宽；④ 开窗前 5 分钟内三点基线 + monitor 60/60 + 零编译仍全适用。
s2_preapproval.wording_note: team must not add any unapproved condition; this text is the approved wording (the earlier draft wrongly added '连续', removed in the 2026-11-08 fix round)
conditions: applies to the collection window (G-L1) only; the G-L0 pilot still uses regular thresholds (util<40) and never the exception
G-L1 still requires the S-2 dual signature (plan + 5-minute-before baseline + signed floor = baseline_free - 3072 MiB) before it may open
any failure: stop immediately, no retry, no relaxation
3-point baseline within 5 minutes before the window + monitor 60/60 + zero compile all remain fully in force
s2_preapproval.not_extended: does not waive or relax the S-2 dual signature, the G-L0 regular thresholds, the validation-window (G-L2) rules, the failure-stop discipline, or any criterion/threshold/tolerance in the spec

revisions.basis: User decision 2026-11-07 (via Chief): implement everything in order, no cost trade-offs - per-world L v2 discriminability must cover BOTH light-driven rgb and geometry-driven depth/seg; two cameras; pilot retained with C1 AND C2 both pass-margin. Plus P0-1 refit verified (e34df3b7, QA PASS 3e08be09) and L v1 reference B-class downgrade (2026-11-07-render-perworld-l-v1-reference-discriminability-check, evidence c318cebb).
items: Two cameras: keep cam-persp (lighting view) and add fixed cam-hinge (geometry view: mode 0, pos -0.0925 0.4981 0.8296, quat -0.211088 -0.149763 0.558924 0.787792, fovy 30, resolution 320x240); cam_active = [true,true,false]; 153,600 px/world

Criterion C split: C1 = cam-persp adjacent-world pixels with max_channel |delta rgb| >= 1/255; C2 = cam-hinge adjacent-world depth bit-changed and seg pair-changed pixels; BOTH must reach 384 acceptance / 576 collection pre-threshold on both adjacent world pairs
Layout/volume for two cameras: rgb_w{k}_cam{0,1} / depth_w{k}_cam{0,1} / seg_w{k}_cam{0,1}; ~11.07 MB/tag

Fact base: view composition (cam-persp floor 59,805 + bg 16,995, zero geometry pixels at every hinge angle tested; cam-hinge moving geometry 24k-31k px), C1 prediction 55,581/55,839 px, C2 prediction depth 35,812/33,947 and seg 16,041/16,755 px; all labelled CPU predictions pending pilot
P0-1 refit written as prerequisite (without it C2 degenerates to 0)
Failure conditions extended to both cameras and C1/C2; self-check order, guard inputs (9 -> 10), S-2 preconditions (4 -> 6), GO list (new G-L0 pilot) synchronized
